h.name: Hamzat ul Wasl
h.description: Silent connecting hamza at the start of a word.

s.name: Silent
s.description: A silent letter or vowel mark.

l.name: Lam Shamsiyyah
l.description: Solar lam, assimilated into (silent before) the following letter.

q.name: Qalqalah
q.description: Echoing/bouncing sound on ق ط ب ج د when sakin.

f.name: Ikhafa
f.description: Hidden nasalization of noon sakinah/tanween before certain letters.

i.name: Iqlab
i.description: Conversion of noon sakinah/tanween into a hidden meem before ب.

a.name: Idgham With Ghunnah
a.description: Merging noon sakinah/tanween into a following letter, with nasalization.

u.name: Idgham Without Ghunnah
u.description: Merging noon sakinah/tanween into ل or ر, without nasalization.

b.name: Idgham Mutaqaribayn
b.description: Merging of two letters with close articulation points.

d.name: Idgham Mutajanisayn
d.description: Merging of two letters sharing the same articulation point.

g.name: Ghunnah
g.description: Obligatory nasalization on نّ and مّ (noon/meem with shaddah).
